issues: ACCESSIBILITY (foundations owner): text/on-danger (#F5F6F6 after re-theme) on status/danger-strong #DC2626 is 4.46:1, which fails AA for 14 px danger-button labels. Fix: alias text/on-danger to paper/0 #FFFFFF (4.83:1) or use red/700 as the fill. Documented as an action card in DS-02.4; I did not change the token because foundations are outside this section.
ACCESSIBILITY: text/danger on surface/raised is 4.37:1 (fails small text). Documented as: keep validation/error text on surface/default or bg (4.89:1), not inside raised tiles or inputs.
ACCESSIBILITY (documented, decorative): border/default on bg/base is 1.46:1. Inputs rely on surface/raised fill + visible label; focus uses border/focus at 9.78:1.

HELPERS: paint() in helpers.js binds variables with a black {0,0,0} fallback colour. Headless renders and screenshots intermittently show that fallback, so icons appear black. In all DS sections I rewrote the fallback of every bound icon stroke/fill to its resolved Dark value (bindings kept). Recommend paint() use the resolved value as fallback for every agent.

FOUNDATIONS: the Gradient/Brand Solid paint style's gradientTransform puts the whole node past the end stop, so it renders as flat #1FBF69 rather than a gradient. Gradient/Brand Glow similarly renders near its end colour. Documented as-is; fix belongs to the foundations owner.

issues: Verification: every set was screenshotted after it was built. Clipping and overlap were fixed and re-screenshotted: risk-meter band labels and outcome text; audit-log, reconciliation and event-stream column widths; reconciliation sub-row wrapping; filter-bar overflow, fixed by splitting it into a controls row and a filters row and collapsing the spacers; OTP resend and status rows in the dialog; placeholder colours. Gotcha for other agents: the text fill override on the nested Select/Field Error variant's 'Value' layer rendered black, although it was bound to text/tertiary through paint(). Re-binding it with setBoundVariableForPaint on a paint that already carries the resolved colour fixed it. When a token override on text inside a nested instance looks black, re-bind it the same way.
An empty figma.createAutoLayout() frame used as a FILL spacer defaults to about 100 px tall, which inflates rows. Set layoutSizingVertical='FIXED' and resize the height to 1.

Width assumption: admin table rows and their headers (Audit Log, Reconciliation, Event Stream, Filter Bar) are 1136 wide, which assumes the admin content area at 1440 with a sidebar. Use FILL inside tables.

Extras beyond the brief: three column-header components (Admin/Audit Log Header, Admin/Reconciliation Header, Admin/Event Stream Header). Some sets have extra state axes: Interaction=Hover on the device and session rows, SLA axis on the queue card, Focus/Hover on the permission cell, Chain alert on the audit row.

Example values not on the demo sheet: all are DEMO-badged and don't conflict with it. They are: AR-1039/1042/1043, INV-0192, AML-3317/AML-3342, SCR-5521, audit entries #88213/#88241/#88244, block numbers and tx hashes for VRF/settlement/refund events, WD-20950, deprecated GlobalPool v1.2.4 0x61e0…b3a8, masked device IPs, 2FA enabled 3 Mar 2026, queue SLA metrics.

Compliance by design: no component offers result editing, winner selection, arbitrary payouts, ledger edits or balance adjustments. Sensitive actions route through the confirm-with-reason dialog and the four-eyes approval card. The circuit-breaker pause affects new entries only and needs dual approval. Reconciliation mismatches open an investigation and never edit the ledger. Audit rows have no edit or delete affordances.

issues: Palette: the assigned series set (brand/primary, accent/gold, status/info, brand/secondary, status/success) FAILS the dataviz palette validator as five free categories on surface/default #2B2F30. brand/primary vs brand/secondary is ΔE 6.0 even with full colour vision; brand/primary vs accent/gold is ΔE 2.1 under protanopia. I kept all five tokens but made the order mint → sky → gold (slots 1–3 PASS: worst CVD ΔE 19.6, normal vision 21.3). Slot 4 (brand/secondary) is restricted to a tonal companion of slot 1; slot 5 (status/success) only when the data means success; the tail folds into chart/other. This is documented in DS-08 and logged as decision #25.
Brand hues sit above the dark lightness band (L 0.72–0.86 vs 0.48–0.70). DS-08 records this as an ACCEPTED brand decision, mitigated by ≥ 3:1 contrast, 2px surface gaps, labels and opt-in patterns.

Foundations: I added 13 Color variables (chart/series-1…5, chart/other, chart/prize-1…4, chart/grid, chart/baseline, chart/crosshair). All are aliases with scopes FRAME_FILL/SHAPE_FILL/STROKE_COLOR and WEB code syntax var(--color-chart-…). Light mode aliases the same targets because Light screens are out of scope.

Prize distribution uses the ordinal ramp chart/prize-1…4 instead of the categorical palette, because ranked prizes are ordered categories (ramp validated PASS). gold/200 and gold/600 are primitives, wrapped by the chart/prize aliases.

Overlap with CMP-15: Game/Crash Curve (25:17535) and Game/Roulette Cell (25:16416) already existed. Chart/Multiplier Curve is the analytic version (axes, cash-out markers, round detail) and uses the same growth function m(t)=e^(0.1117t). Heat Strip cells reuse the same wheel tokens rather than the 56×64 felt cell. Neither component was edited.

Data consistency: the 14-day line chart assumes one round per day (#1,235 on 14 Nov … #1,248 on 27 Nov, 08:00–20:00 UTC), which matches demo-data.md for #1,244–#1,248. Platform fees per round are derived as pool × 0.5% (#1,248 = 932.00). This differs from the admin 30-day KPI of 60,700.00 fees from 1,214,000 entries, which implies about 2 rounds per day. That conflict is in demo-data.md itself; the orchestrator should pick a round cadence.

Demo values I invented and that are not in demo-data.md: rounds #1,235–#1,243 pool values; #1,245 pool of 46,850.00 with 412 players and 4,685 entries; daily deposits by network; Orbit Rush round #88,214 with cash-outs by @orbit_77 (2.40×) and @mira.sol (3.00×); 50 roulette spins #88,141–#88,190 (23 red / 23 black / 4 zero); dice histogram counts; Degraded 99.62% and Outage 98.40% gauge states; KYC Level 3 'enhanced (optional)' at 2 of 4 steps in the DS-08 examples. All are DEMO-badged; add them to demo-data.md if other screens should reuse them.
